class.name: LinesData
class.description: The wires of power lines, mostly: pairs of points, drawn by [code]SceneryLines[/code] and merged with their neighbours ([SceneryLinesGeometry]).

method.name: translated
method.description: A copy of the lines moved by [param offset].

members.member: The lines in the world, pairs of points - a strip or a loop turned into pairs as it was read.
Visible up to this distance from the lines' centre, 0 - no limit.
The lines' width; a negative one is a line that does not fade with the distance.
